policies.duplicate_charge: If a customer is debited more than once for the same order, the extra amount is automatically refunded to the original payment method within 5-7 working days.
policies.failed_order_refund: If an order shows PAYMENT_FAILED but money was debited, the full amount is refunded within 5-7 working days, or the customer can ask us to confirm the order instead.
policies.late_delivery: If an order arrives more than 60 minutes after the promised time, the customer receives a Rs. 50 FreshKart credit, added automatically after delivery.
policies.privacy: Never ask customers for full card number, CVV, UPI PIN, or OTP. Only use masked phone numbers. Never share the delivery partner's phone number.
